name: the side bar is not moved to the right
why: sa_bb_sidebar_right (default on) puts #side-bar after #main-content; without the move it stays first.

name: the side bar does not start collapsed
why: With sa_sidebar_collapsed (default on) the side bar starts hidden, as MusicBrainz's does.
grep: moves to the right|collapses to the left

name: the side bar is pinned by the sticky page headers
why: Without the exclusion the flex-laid-out side bar is a pinned body, sticky against the LEFT, pushed past the widened table.

name: the right side bar is not sticky
why: Once the content is widened to the table, the side bar's natural place is far to the right; sticky right: 0 keeps it at the window's edge.

name: the handle does not follow layout changes
why: A rendered table moves the side bar without a scroll or resize; the ResizeObserver re-places the handle.
